d:
Official music video for the original single "Fly Away" by Vidya Vox ft. MaatiBaani.
Hey guys! While in college, I joined GW Raas and it was one of the most impactful experiences of my life. I fell in love with garba and raas, especially the music. We wrote "Fly Away" last year in Ahmedabad while on the Kuthu Fire Tour - We also flew to Ahmedabad to shoot this! Collaborating again with our long time friends MaatiBaani, who are true Ahmedabadis, was amazing! Big shoutout to everyone who helped on the production, as well as the dancers who were champs in the heat!
